nodes.title:
Blind-teardown calibration on Bolna:
- 16 of 20 pre-registered checkable inferences correct, 4 partly, 0 wrong (hit 0.90, Brier 0.089).
- Strict scoring (minor detail errors count as partly): 10 correct, 10 partly (0.75).
- By evidence: docs-led 13/14 correct, bundle-led 2/5.
- Mechanisms read from bundle config flags were fully right 1 time in 4.
- Stated confidence (mean 0.69) was under the observed rate.
nodes.n: 20 pre-registered rows (checkable_in_oss=true, contamination none/possible) of 35 blind inferences; 24 incl. the 4 contaminated rows (20 correct, 4 partly); 11 not checkable (0 contradicted by code, 2 core-confirmed, 6 consistent, 3 silent). An independent second rater (acct-bolna lane, same SHA) scored 14 TRUE / 6 PARTLY / 0 FALSE (0.85) and agrees on 18/20 rows (kappa 0.74).
nodes.method:
Blind public-surface inference scored against source:
- Inputs: docs, JS bundles, DNS/CT, job posts. File frozen 2026-10-20T16:25Z, sha256 ac22eecf.
- Scored against github.com/bolna-ai/bolna at bc59921, shallow-cloned 18:52Z and read only.
- Each row gets correct/partly/wrong/not-checkable with the deciding file:line.
- Hit rate = (T + 0.5P) / N; Brier score over stated confidence.
- Strict variant: minor detail errors count as partly.
- One rater, who saw the blind statements.

nodes.title: Bolna open-source engine read at HEAD bc59921 (2026-10-20, MIT). 333 files are hashed in the manifest; tests: 175 files, 2,072 functions. This is the scoring baseline for the blind calibration (l4a read 8e300d9 on 2026-10-16).

Coverage gaps of the blind method: the code has 16 material features the blind pass never inferred.
- 5 were in public docs it had already downloaded (extraction misses): speech-to-speech mode, speculative LLM on EagerEndOfTurn, the web-search tool, end_call-tool hangup, multi-agent routing.
- 10 are code-only: the Claude-Haiku-4.5 language judge plus a Sarvam/Soniox LID leg, self-hosted nemotron-asr-hi ASR, dead filler-audio code, a separate RAG proxy service, interruption and dead-air telemetry, English-only phrase lists, test depth, short finals dropped during agent speech, Azure overflow failover, and heard-text history trim.
- 1 is a method note: OSS defaults differ from the dashboard defaults.

Teardown grading rule: on closed vendors, a mechanism inferred only from a bundle config flag or string is graded 'inferred', at most 0.5, and goes on the account-phase probe list. Structure, absence and inventory inferences backed by docs keep their stated confidence.
nodes.reverse_if: A second open-code calibration (a fresh blind lane on Bolna at a later SHA, or a vendor built on Pipecat/LiveKit with public code) scores flag-derived mechanism inferences at least 80% correct with n of at least 8.

nodes.rationale: 5 of the 13 Bolna features the blind pass missed were in the 1.9 MB docs it had already saved. Free-form reading samples the docs; a checklist forces recall.
nodes.reverse_if: On the next 2 closed vendors, the checklist sweep adds fewer than 1 architecture feature per vendor beyond a free-form pass.

nodes.title:
Bolna turn-taking in code (cascade path):
- Barge-in only fires when an interim transcript has MORE than N words (dashboard N=2, so 3 words) or exactly equals an English stop phrase. Provider speech-start never interrupts.
- A final of N words or fewer spoken over the agent is discarded, so short Hindi replies ('haan ji', 'nahi', 'ruko') are lost.
- A speculative LLM request starts on Deepgram Flux EagerEndOfTurn.
- From turn 3 on, the agent's audio is held for incremental_delay ms.
- In S2S mode the provider's VAD barges in.
This is a testable where-we-win item.

Inference: Bolna serves its own models. Provider 'bolna' ASR defaults to nemotron-asr-hi over the OpenAI Realtime transcription protocol, a 'bolna' LLM provider is treated as self-hosted, and DEEPGRAM_HOST is overridable. So their per-minute COGS on own-model calls sits below the INR 2.0-3.8 default-stack reconstruction (BOL-37), and they have more room to cut price.

v2 note: at bc59921 Bolna's engine still has no cross-call memory and no A/B, bandit or prompt-optimisation loop (confirms l4a at 8e300d9). It already emits the per-call signals such a loop would consume: interruption counts, barge-in recovery, talk-listen time, longest monologue, user-bot latency, and dead air inside replies.

Bolna's engine has 0 lines of India calling-compliance logic (no DND, DLT, NCPR, consent or calling-window code), so anything that exists lives in the closed scheduler or with the buyer. Deepgram's model-improvement opt-out is per agent and, when unset, the env defaults to not opted out; the hosted value is unknown.

calibration.md and the 'Calibration' section of research/2026-10-20/teardown/bolna/report.md were not written: the subagent rule forbids report .md files, and no sibling teardown lane has a report.md either. The full text is in the lane's structured output; the data is in calibration.json.
nodes.closes_when: The main loop writes research/2026-10-20/teardown/bolna/calibration.md and report.md (Calibration section) from calibration.json and the bolna-check structured output.

events.details:
Bolna calibration lane finished. Shallow-cloned github.com/bolna-ai/bolna at bc59921 (read only) and scored all 35 blind inferences, each with its deciding file:line.
Pre-registered set (n=20): 16 correct, 4 partly, 0 wrong; hit 0.90, Brier 0.089. Strict: 10 correct, 10 partly (0.75). Including the 4 contaminated rows: 20 correct, 4 partly of 24. Of the 11 uncheckable rows, 0 were contradicted.
By primary evidence: docs 0.96 (n=14), bundle 0.70 (n=5), network 1/1; job posts and marketing n=0. Mechanisms from config flags: 1 of 4 fully right.
A second rater (acct-bolna lane) scored 14 TRUE / 6 PARTLY (0.85); 18/20 rows agree (kappa 0.74).
Coverage: 16 code features were missed (5 visible in docs, 10 code-only, 1 method note).
Outputs: calibration.json, bolna-check/claims.json (18) and manifest.csv (333 files).
